content: Bepaŋdi Dewit momooŋ timiŋguk doktiŋa Bepaŋ wou nintiloguk
(Kap yoŋ adi Dewitdi youkuk. Nai uŋaniŋ adi Mapme Abimelekdok munta tiŋa me kauleŋ welewele tubune niŋkulu uguk.)
Nu Yahwe helemahelemaŋ niutumbaluwaat, kaŋ ninadifonedi mane gineŋ tomboyoutnit hatuwaak.
Nu Yahwedi nehitubu-lodaguk wendok nadiŋa wou nintilowit, kaŋ metam fofoŋhinit malabumuŋ gineŋ hatiiŋ, adi u nadiŋa welemomooŋ nadineŋ.
Nukut Yahwe wougigitŋiŋ yotubuhautanim, tiŋa indi wanakaŋ wou nintiloloye tinim.
Nu Yahwedi nehitubu-lodawek yoŋa ninadigut, kaŋ yonadine nadinamguk. Unduŋ tiŋa welene gineŋ munta hakuk u liliwenekutnamguk.
Metam Wapum nadisukilitimiiŋ, adi yadi nadifo tiŋa nadisukilitihik wondok meka mu tineŋ.
Nu kada, Yahwe ninadiwene yonadine nadiŋa, malabumuŋ gineniŋ nehikibidakuk.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, metam Yahwe’walaŋ hebeŋ gineŋ hatiŋa gikiŋgoŋ timiiŋ heki adi yadi aŋeloŋiyedi adigut yamaiŋgoŋ yehikelemadi tiŋa yabu-ulidoko tiiŋ.
Yahwe adi momooŋ hinek, unduŋ doktiŋa hidi hide kanadi tiŋale Wapum adi momooŋ u kedem nadidakaleneŋ. Me nediyeŋ adi hebeŋ gineŋ wooŋ hebihatilak adi Bepaŋdi kahaŋ timimbu nadifo kedem tibek.
Yahwe’walaŋ metamŋiye, didimehi eŋ nadisukilitihinit, hidi Wapum hebeŋ gineŋ hatiŋa gikiŋgoŋ timiyaneeŋ. Metam adi’walaŋ hebeŋ gineŋ hatiiŋ heki adi nemek niŋdok baniŋ nemu tiiŋ.
Laion pamala adigili kale nanaŋedok map tiŋa gweheye tiiŋ. Eŋ metam nediyeŋ Yahwe kutnilohi tiiŋ heki adi nemek momohidok baniŋ mu tiiŋ.
O wapmihiwoi, hidi buŋa magi kametnadi tubune Yahwe hebeŋ gineŋ gikiŋgoŋ timiŋa hatihati wendok hanindidime tibit.
Me nediyeŋdi hatihati kweheyeniŋgoŋ hatidok nadisulak, be melenai feegoŋ hatitaloŋila nemenemek nanadifo tihatidok nadilak?
Ala du unduŋ hatidok nadikaaŋ, medehaki mu yoluwaaŋ eŋ mede yalaŋ maaŋ mu yoluwaaŋ.
Du titiŋ hogohi u sigilulum tiyemiŋa titiŋ fofohi u hogok keleeŋ tuluwaaŋ. Du adi metam nolidut welekubugoŋ tiŋa titiŋ fofooŋ uŋakoŋ hogok fafaŋe tiŋa takaliluwaaŋ.
Yahwe adi metam didimehi’walaŋkade dau diwe tilak, unduŋ tiŋa yonadihik nadiyemilak.
Iŋgoŋ Yahwe adi metam kadakaniŋ titiŋ hekidok sigilulum tiyemilak. Unduŋ tubune kumumbu metamdi nadikaule tiyemdok unduŋ tiyemilak.
Metam didimehi adi Yahwe ninadi tiiŋ kaŋ yonadihik nadiyemilak. Unduŋ tiŋa malabumuŋhik gineniŋ yehitubu-lodaaŋ yanagitak.
Yahwe adi metam welemulaphinit yehitubu-dulaaŋ yamaiŋgoŋ uŋgoŋ hatilak, tiŋa adi yadi metam nadikunakunalehik gweheye tilak undihi u yehitubu-lodalak.
Me didimeniŋ’walaŋkade malabumuŋ mebimebi mintamilak, iŋgoŋ Yahwedi tubulodaune malabumuŋdi mu tubugweheyeiŋ.
Wapum adi kunilit wanakaŋ hinek kadokolak, kaŋ kitiliŋiŋ-kabe nemu gololak.
Nemek kadakaniŋ mebimebidi me hogohi widihi-kumuneeŋ, kaŋ me nediyeŋdi me didimehidok mik tiyemilak adi yadi Wapumdi kibikoŋ malabumuŋ hinek timimbaak.
Yahwe adi kwanai-meŋiye kumuŋ gineniŋ kotigoŋ yanagitak kaŋ kaipmuŋ hatiiŋ, ale metam nediyeŋdi adigoŋ yabudokoune hatiiŋ unduŋ nadisukilitiiŋ heki adi yadi tuwot mu yehitubu-kadakawaak, mokoŋ hinek.
